_comment: Example corpus config. Copy this file to corpora.json in RAG_DIR (default ~/rag-service)
and edit it; corpora.json itself is deployment data and is not tracked.
Required keys (paths are relative to RAG_DIR unless absolute):
corpus_dir      where the markdown corpus lives (env RAG_CORPUS_DIR overrides it)
data_dir        where index.sqlite and .index.lock are written
top_files       markdown files at the CORPUS ROOT, e.g. AGENTS.md
doc_root_files  markdown files at the ROOT OF THE docs TREE, i.e. resolved as
exclude_dirs    directory names skipped anywhere inside roots (e.g. archive)
system_note       sentence appended to the retrieve tool description
git_origin_repo   local checkout of the source repo; refresh.sh reads its origin
URL to clone/fetch a git-backed corpus
Only *.md is indexed, and a missing entry is skipped silently rather than failing.

example.system_note: 回答引用時請標明回傳的檔案路徑。
